description: Sync one Mixpanel project's events, daily funnel results, saved cohorts and annotations, with each event's user named from their Mixpanel profile.
opening: Sync one Mixpanel project's events, daily funnel results, saved cohorts and project annotations. Each event is one document that names the event, the user and up to 30 of the event's properties. The user's name and email come from their Mixpanel profile when one exists.

Mixpanel permissions are not imported, so every synced item is visible to everyone who can query the collection unless you set an access rule. Events without an insert id can be treated as one event, so some of them can be lost. Annotations sync only with a service account. Cohorts and annotations deleted in Mixpanel stay in HydraDB.

connect.auth: Mixpanel uses the project's API secret. Add a service account as well to sync annotations.

credentials.name: username
credentials.text: A service account's username, from Organization Settings, Service Accounts. Needed to sync annotations.

credentials.name: password
credentials.text: That service account's secret. Set it together with `username` and `project_id`.

credentials.name: project_id
credentials.text: The Mixpanel project id, a number. Required when you use a service account.

steps.title: Create a service account, for annotations
steps.text: To sync annotations, create a service account in Mixpanel under Organization Settings, Service Accounts. Without one, everything except annotations syncs.

steps.title: Create the connector
steps.text: Paste the project's API secret as `api_secret`. If you created a service account, add its username as `username`, its secret as `password`, and the project id as `project_id`.

steps.title: Configure the connector
steps.text: There is nothing to select. The connector reads the whole project the credentials reach.

connect.account: One connector reads one Mixpanel project.

sync.first_sync: Reaches back the window set by `lookback_days`, 30 days by default. Events and annotations reach back at most 365 days, and funnel results at most 90 days.
sync.changes: Events, funnel results and annotations are read by date. Cohorts are read by when they were created.
sync.edits: An event read again with the same insert id, or a funnel day read again, replaces its document. A cohort is read by its creation time, so a later edit to an older cohort may not come across. A change to a user's profile does not update events already synced.
sync.deletes: Deleted cohorts and annotations are not removed. A cohort or annotation deleted in Mixpanel stays searchable in HydraDB.
notes: If a Mixpanel request keeps failing after retries, the sync fails instead of skipping that data.

shared_attributes.name: connector_id
shared_attributes.text: Limits a query to this connector's items. Not searchable.

documents.name: Events
documents.one_document: One event. An event read again with the same insert id updates the same document. Events without an insert id, as older events can be, may be treated as the same event, and all but one of them lost.
documents.title: The event name, or `Mixpanel event <id>` when there is none.
documents.text: `Event`, `User` and `When` lines, then up to 30 of the event's properties in alphabetical order as `property: value`. Mixpanel's `$` and `mp_reserved_` prefixes are removed from property names. The title is searchable too.
documents.date: The event time in UTC. Times are converted from the project timezone, which defaults to UTC, so events from a project set to another timezone can have shifted times.

attributes.name: event
attributes.text: The event name, written as the title and the `Event` line.

attributes.name: User
attributes.text: The user's name and email from their Mixpanel profile, as `name (email)`. When no profile name or email is found, for example because the Mixpanel plan has no user profiles, the line shows the raw `distinct_id` instead. Older events keep the name and email they were synced with.

attributes.name: time
attributes.text: When the event happened, written as the `When` line. It sets the result date.

attributes.name: Event properties
attributes.text: Up to 30 non-empty properties with a single value each, such as a plan name. Properties past the 30th, and properties whose value is an object or a list, are not kept or searchable.

attributes.name: additional_metadata.mixpanel_event
attributes.text: The event name. Limits a query to one event name. Not searchable.

attributes.name: additional_metadata.mixpanel_distinct_id
attributes.text: The user's `distinct_id`. Limits a query to one user's events, whether or not their profile was found. Not searchable.

documents.name: Funnel days
documents.one_document: One funnel's results for one day.
documents.title: The funnel name, or `Mixpanel funnel <funnel_id>:<date>` when there is none.
documents.text: `Funnel` and `Date` lines, then one line per step: `Step N: <step label or event> - count <count>`. The title is searchable too.

attributes.name: name
attributes.text: The funnel name, written as the title and the `Funnel` line.

attributes.name: date
attributes.text: The day, written as the `Date` line. It sets the result date when Mixpanel supplies no date and time for the day.

attributes.name: datetime
attributes.text: The date and time Mixpanel supplies for the funnel day. When present, it sets the result date. Not searchable.

attributes.name: funnel_id
attributes.text: The funnel id. Searchable only in a title used when the funnel has no name.

attributes.name: additional_metadata.mixpanel_funnel_id
attributes.text: The funnel id. Limits a query to one funnel. Not searchable.

documents.name: Cohorts
documents.title: The cohort name, or `Mixpanel cohort <id>` when there is none.
documents.text: The `Cohort` line, the description and a `Members` line with the member count. The title is searchable too.
documents.files: None. The list of members is not synced.

attributes.name: name
attributes.text: The cohort name, written as the title and the `Cohort` line.

attributes.name: count
attributes.text: How many members the cohort has, written as the `Members` line.

attributes.name: created_at
attributes.text: When the cohort was created, as Mixpanel reports it. Not searchable.

documents.name: Annotations
documents.title: The start of the description, up to 80 bytes, or `Mixpanel annotation` followed by its id when there is no description. A long title in a non-Latin script can be cut in the middle of a character.
documents.text: The annotation's description. The title is searchable too.

attributes.name: description
attributes.text: The annotation text, which also supplies the title.

attributes.name: date
attributes.text: The date the annotation is attached to. Not searchable.

example_searches: When did jane@example.com last complete Checkout Completed?
How many users reached each step of the Onboarding funnel on 2026-11-02?
What is the Power users cohort, and how many members does it have?

connections: None. Events are not linked to funnels, cohorts or each other.
graph.people: No people are attached to items. The user named in an event's `User` line is part of the text only.
graph.from_text: The event, funnel, cohort and annotation text.

not_synced: Annotations, when no service account is set.
Daily event counts and retention reports.
User profiles as their own documents. A profile only supplies the name and email shown on events.
Event properties past the 30th, and properties whose value is an object or a list.
Deletions: cohorts and annotations deleted in Mixpanel stay in HydraDB.
